propositions: The module-size allowlist is drained to zero; retire the grandfathering escape hatch and make 800 LOC an absolute cap
Introduce .github/module-size-limit.txt as the single source of the limit (800), read by both CI gate workflows and the contract test
Rewrite the Module-size gate in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to enforce absolute cap without allowlist, and lock the limit by comparing against main's version fetched via explicit GitHub URL
The limit-lock must fail with an override message if main's limit differs from the current change's limit, warn on fetch failure, and bootstrap if main lacks the file
The gate must fail if the limit file is missing or unparseable, and must not read allowlist or ceilings files
Update test_module_size_contract.py to drop allowlist/ceilings assertions and verify no src/rebar file exceeds the limit-file cap; update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to reference the new limit file
